title: Configuration with an inserted choice tape
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, $S$ a type of states, and $x$ a finite Boolean input. Given a configuration $c$ with $k+1$ Boolean work tapes and state set $S$ on input $x$, a tape $t$ assigning an optional Boolean symbol to each integer position, and an integer head position $p$, define a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes and state set $S \oplus \mathrm{Fin}(3)$ on the same input. Its state is the state of $c$ tagged by the left injection, its input-head position and output are those of $c$, and its work tapes and their head positions are obtained by inserting $t$ and $p$, respectively, at the designated choice-tape slot.
